system.name: Dashlet
system.one_liner: a short-video streaming system that models per-user swipe timing to make robust chunk-prefetch decisions

content.subject: the branching chunk-distance variable D21 and the chain of swipe-or-continue decisions from c21 to later chunks of video 2

elements.name: c11
elements.role: first chunk of video 1; how many of its chunks were watched before the first swipe is not yet fixed

elements.name: c21
elements.role: first chunk of video 2, reached once the user swipes away from video 1

elements.name: c23
elements.role: next chunk of video 2 reached if the user keeps watching past c21 (labelled c23 in the source figure)

elements.name: c23
elements.role: final chunk of video 2 reached if the user keeps watching past the previous chunk as well

elements.name: Swipe
elements.role: marks the branch where the user leaves video 2 instead of continuing to the next chunk

content.key_idea: Reaching a later chunk of video 2 requires surviving one independent swipe-away decision at every intervening chunk, each with its own probability.
content.reading_order: left to right: three parallel D21 branches from c11 converge at c21, then the chain repeats a continue-or-swipe decision at each further chunk toward c23

summary: This figure continues Dashlet's chunk-viewing model past the first swipe, tracing the path from chunk c11 of video 1 to later chunks of video 2. Three parallel branches from c11 converge at c21, one for each value of D21 (1, 2, or 3), the number of video-1 chunks watched before the user first swiped away. From c21 onward the model becomes a repeating unit: at each chunk the user either keeps watching, advancing the cumulative chunk count (D21+1, then D21+2) toward the next chunk of video 2, or swipes away again with probability p21 or p22, drawn as a red curved arrow labelled Swipe. The figure argues that reaching any later chunk of video 2 requires surviving one independent swipe decision per intervening chunk. The source figure labels both the middle and the final chunk boxes c23, though the surrounding text implies the middle one is c22.
